IT IS APPARENT THAT PLAINTIFF HAS SOUGHT TO EFFECT SERVICE UNDER CCP SECTION 415.30 BY SENDING EACH DEFENDANT AN ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF RECEIPT FORM. AS PLAINTIFF RECOGNIZES, SUCH SERVICE CAN BE EFFECTIVE ONLY ON RETURN OF THE ACKNOWLEDGMENT, WHICH HAS NOT HAPPENED. ABSENT THAT, THE ONLY CONSEQUENCE IS A POTENTIAL SHIFTING OF COSTS FOR SUBSEQUENT SERVICE. BECAUSE THE MAILING DOES NOT ITSELF PURPORT TO BE SERVICE, THERE IS NOTHING TO QUASH. JUDGE: PETER J.
